title: [v0.52.0] Utility sub-agent handoff regression: 0 input tokens passed to main model on startup
before: During late-bound context rendering, ContextManager concatenated the rendered history and pending history, hardened the combined turns, and searched for the first pending turn by ID. It accepted both the raw pending ID and a turn_-prefixed form, but unconditionally excluded the stable environment-context ID and its prefixed form from being the pending boundary. The graph mapper intentionally assigns a first turn containing <session_context> that stable environment-context identity, so a startup request carrying that header could remain in the historical result instead of starting pendingApiHistory, even when it was the final hardened turn.
after: The history partitioner still recognizes raw and turn_-prefixed pending IDs, but it now treats the stable environment-context identity as an excluded startup context only when that turn is not the final hardened turn. If the environment-context turn is the final turn, it is allowed to start the pending segment, so pendingApiHistory retains the startup request. The client can then append that processed pending content to the managed API history used for the main-model request. A regression test verifies that a pending request containing <session_context> produces exactly one pending API item containing the header.
diff: Commit 571851b1077a51cef757146ce13f9da887326bec changes packages/core/src/context/contextManager.ts and its test. The implementation extracts pending-ID recognition into isPendingId, introduces isStartupContext for earlier environment-context turns, and changes the boundary condition so only non-final startup context is suppressed. The commit adds a focused test that calls renderHistory with a pending <session_context> request and asserts that pendingApiHistory contains the request.

evidence_units.claim: The issue is titled '[v0.52.0] Utility sub-agent handoff regression: 0 input tokens passed to main model on startup'; the bundle routes it under concurrent-work-coordination and identifies issue 28518 with the pinned and resolved commit.
The pinned commit is implementation-bearing: its subject identifies issue 28518 and its stat changes contextManager.ts plus contextManager.test.ts with 40 insertions and 8 deletions.

Relative to parent 2ad220a8205ea4f533a3667fb8ca60575dbcebff, the code replaces the inline pending-ID and unconditional environment-ID exclusion with isPendingId plus an isStartupContext check that is true only for a non-final hardened turn.

The graph builder detects a text part beginning with <session_context> on the first input turn and assigns that turn the stable environment-context identity; later legacy session-context headers are skipped.

When lateBindPrompt is enabled, the renderer excludes the most recent turn from managed history and returns that turn as pendingHistory, both in the within-budget path and in the pressure-barrier path.
ContextManager hardens renderedHistory plus pendingHistory, derives pendingIds from pendingHistory, and maps the resulting history partition into apiHistory and pendingApiHistory.

The main client invokes ContextManager.renderHistory with a pending request, selects the first processed pendingApiHistory item when available, and constructs apiHistoryOverride as historical API content followed by the final pending content.
The client passes apiHistoryOverride through Turn.run and GeminiChat.sendMessageStream; GeminiChat uses the override, after scrubbing, as requestContents for the model API call.

The existing ContextManager test establishes the normal partition contract: historical environment context and prior model content remain in apiHistory, only the active prompt is in pendingApiHistory, and the combined roles alternate.
The added regression test passes a pending user turn containing <session_context> to renderHistory and asserts pendingApiHistory has one item whose text contains <session_context>.
The targeted test command was attempted but could not execute because the workspace did not recognize the vitest executable; therefore no independent runtime pass result is claimed.

candidate_atomics.name: classify_final_startup_context_as_pending
candidate_atomics.description: Preserve a late-bound startup request carrying session context in the pending API segment when its normalized environment-context identity is the final hardened turn, while continuing to treat an earlier environment context turn as historical.

semantic_action.intent: Preserve active startup or sub-agent handoff content for the upcoming main-model request instead of losing it at the history/pending boundary.
semantic_action.pre_state: A pending request containing <session_context> is mapped as the stable environment-context turn; after hardening, its identity may be raw or turn_-prefixed, and the previous classifier excluded that identity even when it was the final turn.
semantic_action.post_state: Pending-ID variants are recognized, and the environment-context identity is suppressed only for an earlier startup context; when it is the final hardened turn, it starts the pending segment and the request appears in pendingApiHistory.
semantic_action.validation: The added ContextManager regression test requires one pending API item whose text contains <session_context>; the client call site then consumes that pending item as the final content appended to apiHistoryOverride.
parameters: raw or turn_-prefixed normalized turn identifier

candidate_atomics.name: assert_startup_pending_partition_regression
candidate_atomics.description: Add a focused regression oracle for the special startup session-context boundary while retaining the existing normal late-binding split and role-alternation checks.

semantic_action.intent: Detect regressions that return a startup session-context request as historical content or an empty pending API segment.
semantic_action.pre_state: The normal pending split is covered, but a first pending turn beginning with <session_context> can be assigned the environment-context identity and be misclassified by the boundary logic.
semantic_action.post_state: The regression suite requires exactly one pending API item containing <session_context>, while the existing test continues to require that an ordinary active prompt is the only pending item and that the combined sequence alternates roles.
semantic_action.validation: The assertions in contextManager.test.ts directly inspect pendingApiHistory and the combined role sequence; the test was not executable in this checkout because vitest was unavailable.
